summary:
Builder and technical leader serving as SVP of Software Engineering at Trilogy, leading 0→1 product development across a portfolio of educational technology products. Edtech work spans three pillars: learning applications (7+ apps including AI tutoring, spaced repetition games, adaptive platforms), content generation infrastructure (curriculum modeling, AI-powered authoring, publishing workflows), and learning analytics (engagement tracking, mastery measurement, outcome correlation).

Implemented learning science principles directly: spaced repetition, mastery-based progression, automaticity building, knowledge graph-driven curricula. This enables thousands of Alpha School students to achieve 99th percentile outcomes.

Player-coach approach: combine strategic leadership ($6M budget, team of 40) with hands-on execution as product manager, architect, and full-stack engineer. Prior: 6+ years Lead Software Engineer at msg systems, SAP Developer Hero.
achievements: Shipped 7+ learning products from concept to production spanning learning apps (TrashCat, Athena, TeachTap, TeachTales), content infrastructure (Incept), and analytics (TimeBack), implementing spaced repetition, mastery-based progression, and knowledge graph-driven curricula.
Extended Crossover hiring platform processing hundreds of thousands of monthly visitors and tens of thousands of applications, implementing AI-powered screening and assessment grading.
Led strategic AI adoption across organization during 2024, achieving productivity gains while industry-wide metrics declined.
Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 50% and outages by 5x for $20M ARR SaaS product (Playbooks).
